title: Step-by-step quantitative analysis of focal adhesions
author: Horzum, Ozdil, et al.

steps.title: Immunostain cells for vinculin
steps.instruction: Incubate fixed MDA‑MB‑231 cells with vinculin primary antibody (Sigma Cat no V9131) followed by a fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibody according to standard immunostaining procedures.

steps.title: Acquire calibrated fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Capture 8‑bit images on an Olympus epi‑fluorescence microscope using a 100× oil UPlanSApo objective (NA 1.4) and an Olympus SLR E‑330 camera; set image dimensions to 3136 × 2352 pixels and calibrate the scale so that 37 pixels correspond to 2 µm.

steps.title: Process image in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Open the acquired image in ImageJ and apply the following processing steps in order:

substeps.instruction: Subtract background: Process → Subtract Background, select “Sliding paraboloid” and set rolling‑ball radius to 50 pixels.
Enhance local contrast: Plugins → CLAHE, set block size = 19, histogram bins = 256, maximum slope = 6, no mask, fast mode.
Apply exponential transformation: Process → Math → Exp to further reduce background.
Auto‑adjust brightness & contrast: Image → Adjust → Brightness/Contrast, click “Auto”.
Apply Log3D filter: Plugins → Log3D, set sigma X = 5 and sigma Y = 5 (2D mode).
Threshold image: Image → Adjust → Threshold, choose “Default” method and allow automatic threshold adjustment.
Analyze particles: Analyze → Analyze Particles, set size = 50‑Infinity, circularity = 0.00‑0.99, and record measurements.

steps.title: Overlay and save particle outlines
steps.instruction: Save the outlines generated by the Analyze Particles command, overlay them on the original fluorescence image to visually confirm accurate focal‑adhesion detection, and store the resulting image.
